description:
Create a custom symmetric airfoil using QBlade's Direct Foil Design module. 

1. Open the 'Direct Foil Design' module (NOT the NACA generator).
2. Use the spline control points to design a symmetric airfoil (upper and lower surfaces should be mirror images).
3. Adjust the shape to achieve a maximum thickness of approximately 15% of the chord.
4. Name the airfoil 'SymCustom15'.
5. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/custom_spline_foil.wpa'.
